the fiber in both single or hybrid form can effectively improve the toughness and ductile capacity of LWAC.

The main takeaway from our work is that

a combination of carbon and polyppropylene fibers can significantly improve the toughness ratio and ductile capacity of LWAC, which is of great importance for improving the energy absorption and post-cracking performance of LWAC.
